decision_conditions:
The energy statement needs to meet the following requirements as set out by our LVC (it does not appear to address certain points such as how the development achieves net-zero). 
We highly recommend they use a qualified energy/sustainability consultant to prepare this:
An Energy Statement must clearly outline how the proposed Energy Strategy aligns with the London Plan's Energy Hierarchy and Local Plan policies. The statement should include, as a minimum:
1. How on-site emissions savings will be maximised by following the GLA energy hierarchy: Be Lean, Be Clean, and Be Green.
2. Demonstrate how the development will achieve net zero carbon, including meeting the minimum on-site carbon reduction specified in Local Plan Policy 4.
Where achieving this minimum on-site is not feasible, applicants must provide evidence that all options have been explored.
3. Assess the development's energy demand and carbon emissions, showing the expected savings from energy efficiency and renewable energy measures.
4. Clearly outline the approach to energy supply, including details on decentralised energy where relevant.
5. Include sufficient detail to demonstrate that the proposed strategy is achievable and aligns with relevant policies.
6. Address any requirements for carbon offsetting where on-site reductions are insufficient. Note: a financial contribution to the Carbon Offset Fund will only
be accepted where it has been demonstrated that all feasible on-site energy efficiency and renewable energy measures have been implemented.
7. Include written confirmation that the applicant will cover the cost of any independent assessment commissioned by the Council, where necessary
